title: Benchmarking Compositional Generalisation for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
abstract: arXiv:2605.08988v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials play a fundamental role in computational chemistry and materials science, enabling applications from molecular dynamics simulations to drug design and materials discovery. While recent approaches can estimate inter-atomic forces with high precision, it remains unclear to what extent they can generalise to previously unseen molecules. Do they learn the compositional structure of chemistry, capturing how molecular fragments and their combinations determine properties, or do they primarily learn to interpolate patterns that are specific to the training examples? To address this question, we propose a benchmark consisting of four tasks that require some form of compositional generalisation. translated_title: 面向机器学习原子间势的组合泛化基准测试
translated_abstract: 机器学习原子间势在计算化学和材料科学中发挥着基础性作用，支持从分子动力学模拟到药物设计和材料发现等广泛应用。尽管近期的方法能够以高精度估计原子间作用力，但它们在多大程度上能够泛化到此前未见过的分子仍不明确。它们究竟是学习到了化学的组合结构，即捕捉分子片段及其组合如何决定性质，还是主要学习对训练样本特有模式进行插值？为了回答这一问题，我们提出了一个由四个任务组成的基准测试，这些任务都需要某种形式的组合泛化能力。在每个任务中，模型都在训练期间未见过的分子上进行测试，但训练数据的选取方式使得对于学习了潜在化学组合结构的模型而言，对测试样本进行泛化应当是可行的。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由四个任务组成的基准测试，用以评估机器学习原子间势是真正学习到化学的组合结构并能泛化到未见分子，还是仅仅在训练数据上进行插值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a benchmark of four tasks to assess whether machine learning interatomic potentials learn the compositional structure of chemistry and generalise to unseen molecules, or merely interpolate training patterns.
